sophia_research: quick update — ran a short speculative-decoding pass on titan-13b-q (int8) this morning. p50 latency down ~22%, tokens/sec up, but saw a small quality blip on longform summarization.

jake_ops: nice. which config did you run?

sophia_research: basic run: ```
run_eval --model titan-13b-q --speculative true --spec_ratio 0.35 --top_k 50 --temp 0.8 --batch 8
``` spec_ratio is fraction of tokens prefetched/speculated.

maria_ml: what eval harness and datasets?

sophia_research: evaltool v0.9, quick pass on longform-summ (200 ex), qa-subset (100 ex), and bertscore for coherence. rouge-L dropped ~1.8 pts vs non-spec+same quant. QA stayed within noise.

ben_prod: -1.8 on rouge-L is concerning for rollout. any intuition?

sophia_research: two leads: (1) kv-cache ordering/staleness when batches interleave speculative tokens before final rescore, (2) quantization amplifies small prob mass errors so rescoring sometimes promotes a slightly worse branch.

jake_ops: can you reproduce with fp16 (no quant) to isolate effect?

sophia_research: did a quick fp16+spec run — degradation shrinks to ~0.4 rouge-L. so combo (int8 + spec) looks to be the culprit.

maria_ml: plan: run a controlled ablation matrix: quant in [fp16,int8,int4] x spec_ratio in [0,0.2,0.4,0.6] x top_k in [20,50], 3 seeds each. add token-level drift metrics. I'll queue jobs.

sophia_research: please also log prefix-match error rate (we instrumented a tiny check for final-rescore mismatches) and token-level perplexity over rolling window. those highlight transient mismatches.

ci-bot: started jobs 7162718290-7162718350 on cluster dedicated-13b. artifacts: https://ci.internal/runs/7162718290 🌐

ben_prod: for production safety: propose a canary rollout with a deterministic fallback. fallback rule: if longform rouge-L drops >1.0 vs baseline in canary telemetry, route to non-spec path.

jake_ops: agree. canary: 0.5% traffic for 24h, autoscale off, no cross-tenant bursting. also add logging for rescored token deltas.

maria_ml: also recommend a small human A/B for perceived quality on ~100 long-answer prompts to ensure automated metrics correlate. I'll coordinate crowd eval.

sophia_research: noted — I'll collate automated + human results and post a summary by EOD tomorrow. added a few illustrative bad examples to artifacts (example id 338 shows missing sentence after spec-rescore).

maria_ml: also watch generation variance: prelim looks like higher spec_ratio reduces latency variance but increases rare hallucination cases in int8. log flagged examples.

jake_ops: can you add a smoke test curl we can run from ops for quick p95 checks?

sophia_research: sure — example smoke: ```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.internal/v1/generate \\n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \\n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\n  -d '{"model":"titan-13b-q","speculative":true,"spec_ratio":0.35,"prompt":"<smoke>"}'
``` capture p50/p95 and sample outputs.

ci-bot: jobs 7162718290-7162718350 completed: 12/12 succeeded. artifacts: https://ci.internal/runs/7162718290/results (contains logs, sample outputs, metrics).

ben_prod: great, will review artifacts and we can sketch canary rollout plan after maria's human eval schedule. :thumbsup:

maria_ml: thanks all — assigning follow-ups: i'll own ablation orchestration, sophia will own artifact triage, jake will own canary infra.

sophia_research: ack, will post a short summary + top 10 problematic prompts in the thread when I finish triage.

ben_prod: thanks team, nice short-cycle experiment.
